 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Boston Bruins (13-4-1) continue their home stand as they take on the Montreal Canadiens (11-3-4) on Thursday night.
 The game will be a matchup of two of the best teams in the league. Currently, Boston sits at the top of the Atlantic Division with 27 points and Montreal is narrowly behind in third with 26 points.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement As for the Eastern Conference standings, the Bruins are in second place behind the Carolina Hurricanes, and the Canadiens are fourth.
 "Yeah, energy was really good, said Bruins head coach Marco Sturm. "Not sure if it's because of Montreal, but I think the guys are in a good spot right now. I do believe we know what it takes to win a hockey game and we just got to make sure, I know my guys will be ready, and we just got to make sure we're going to be smart and play the right way, again, against a very good hockey team."
